extra.name: TRON
extra.notes: Fees are paid in resources: bandwidth (600 free a day) and energy for contracts, else TRX is burned.

capabilities.wallets: yes: Helm-managed keys (secp256k1, TRON address format) and watch-only addresses
capabilities.balances: yes: TRX and TRC-20 by contract address
capabilities.token_metadata: yes: TRC-20 name, symbol, decimals read from the contract
capabilities.transfers: yes: TRX and TRC-20, with bandwidth, energy and account-activation costs in the preview; final once solidified
capabilities.launches: yes: SunPump (name and symbol on-chain; SunPump's own site doesn't show an image for them)
capabilities.swaps: partial: buys and sells on SunPump's bonding curve; SunSwap (after graduation) isn't routed
capabilities.market_data: no: no provider coverage verified for Helm's market views on TRON yet
capabilities.cross_chain: no: Helm's route provider (Relay) isn't wired for TRON

extra.name: NEAR
extra.notes: Accounts are names (alice.near) or 64-hex implicit accounts; tokens need a storage deposit.

capabilities.wallets: yes: Helm-managed ed25519 keys as implicit accounts, and watch-only named or implicit accounts
capabilities.balances: yes: NEAR (available, after storage) and NEP-141 tokens by contract account
capabilities.history: partial: Helm's own transfers only; NEAR has no official account-history API
capabilities.transfers: yes: NEAR and NEP-141 (with the recipient's storage registration when needed); final execution awaited
capabilities.launches: yes: Meme.Cooking fair-launch auctions (needs PINATA_JWT for the image)
capabilities.swaps: partial: deposit into and withdraw from Meme.Cooking auctions; Ref Finance isn't routed
capabilities.market_data: no: no provider coverage verified for Helm's market views on NEAR yet
capabilities.cross_chain: no: Helm's route provider isn't wired for NEAR

extra.name: Arc
extra.notes: Gas is paid in USDC. Native USDC has 18 decimals; its ERC-20 interface (0x3600…) shows the same balance with 6 decimals, so it is never counted twice.

capabilities.wallets: yes: Helm-managed EVM keys and watch-only addresses
capabilities.balances: yes: USDC (native, 18 decimals) and ERC-20 tokens such as EURC
capabilities.history: partial: Helm's own transfers only; no official Arc history API is documented
capabilities.transfers: yes: USDC and ERC-20, gas paid in USDC; final at one confirmation (deterministic finality)
capabilities.launches: yes: Tolly (Uniswap V3 token/USDC pool with locked liquidity; verified source)
capabilities.swaps: partial: buys and sells of Tolly tokens through Arc's Uniswap V3 SwapRouter02
capabilities.market_data: no: no provider coverage verified for Arc
capabilities.cross_chain: no: not wired in this release

extra.name: TON
extra.notes: Your own wallet signs through TON Connect; Helm never holds TON keys. Jettons move through the sender's jetton wallet with 0.05 TON attached (the unused part comes back).

capabilities.wallets: yes: your own wallet via TON Connect (bound with a signed ton_proof) and watch-only addresses; Helm-managed TON keys aren't offered
capabilities.balances: yes: TON and Jettons by master address (toncenter index)
capabilities.token_metadata: yes: Jetton name, symbol, decimals from the index (decimals default to 9)
capabilities.transfers: yes: TON and Jettons, approved and signed in your wallet; followed by message hash until final
capabilities.launches: no: no TON launchpad integrated with verified contracts and terms
capabilities.swaps: no: no TON DEX route integrated in this release
capabilities.market_data: no: no provider coverage verified for Helm's market views on TON yet
capabilities.cross_chain: no: Helm's route provider isn't wired for TON
